Package org.tasktide.engine.trackers

Class ExecutorServiceTracker<T extends TaskTideModel<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.trackers.ExecutorServiceTracker<T>
Type Parameters:
T - of TaskTideModel of WorkItem, ItemTask
public class ExecutorServiceTracker<T extends TaskTideModel<T>> extends Object
Generic class to hold logic for tracking futures of TaskTideModel elements (ie ItemTask, WorkItem) as ExecutorServiceItem.
